sources.title: GitHub - Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
sources.snippet: For most work, use minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors (from the LoRA repo). It's the strongest checkpoint so far: much better static / small-motion shots, markedly better micro-detail (faces, fingers, texture), and the over-sharpening / plastic look of the earlier v1 (~850) line is fully resolved. v4 introduced a static-frame enhancement.
